labels: Drag it up your body, elbows back

text.setup: Stand tall holding the bar against your thighs, hands shoulder-width, palms up.
cues: Pull your elbows back as you curl, so the bar slides up your body.
Keep the bar touching or nearly touching you all the way.
Stop at your lower chest, then lower it back down your body.
mistakes: Letting the bar swing out in front, which makes it a normal curl.

variants.dumbbells: Drag the bells up your sides.
variants.smith: The track keeps the bar close, but set your feet so it can travel straight.
variants.cable: Stand close to a low pulley so the cable runs up your body.
